Irene: midweek mood check  need a short movie or 2-3 eps show + a chill indie/alt playlist for painting miniatures tonight. low brain, high cozy.
Carlos: Movie: 'The Grand Budapest Hotel'  colorful and ~100 min. Show: 'Detectorists' (2 seasons, eps ~30m). Music: Lucy Dacus, HAIM, or early Arcade Fire.
Jen: if you want really mellow: 'Our Little Sister' (Japanese, gentle, 120 min) or the miniseries 'A Very English Scandal' (3 eps). Playlist: "soft indie + shoegaze" works while painting.
Irene: @Carlos love The Grand Budapest idea. @Jen never heard of Our Little Sister, adding it. any quick playlist I can toss on?
PlaylistBot: Created playlist "Redwood Cozy Paint Night" and added to @Irene queue: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example-cozy (demo).
Carlos: tiny DIY mix (paste into queue):
```
1. Lucy Dacus - Night Shift
2. Beach House - Myth
3. Yo La Tengo - Autumn Sweater
4. Cigarettes After Sex - K.
5. Big Thief - Paul
```
Jen: poll: movie (Grand Budapest / Our Little Sister) vs Detectorists eps?
Irene: vote: Grand Budapest :star_struck:
Carlos: vote: Detectorists (light laughs during painting) :laughing:
Jen: vote: Our Little Sister (soothing) :sparkling_heart:
Irene: tied! guess I'll alternate. thanks everyone, playlist queued and brushes at the ready.
Carlos: post-painting show report pls :eyes:
